environment.docker_server: Docker Desktop Linux VM / Engine 29.7.2 / linux arm64
environment.isolation: disposable namespaces and local filesystem fixtures; no host reboot, daemon restart or production storage fault was injected
environment.target_checks: Docker canary namespaces were unique and cleaned; destructive host/daemon/storage drills were not run because the target also hosts unrelated workloads

passed.name: process ownership, guardian fencing and blocked-controller detection
passed.coverage: guardian death, simultaneous starters, paused owner, process-group termination, quiet workload and bounded restart budget

passed.name: launcher crash/hang, active receipt recovery and quiet workload
passed.evidence: npm run test:relay:recovery; 42 tests passed; three additional launcher/worker fixture repetitions passed
passed.coverage: real launcher process lifecycle with fixture registry/discovery; unknown receipt remains non-replayable; normal long-running and quiet work included

passed.name: durable receipt, admission, expiry/eviction and older snapshot fixtures
passed.evidence: relay recovery suite and lifecycle recovery tests
passed.coverage: write failures, read-only permissions, bounded receipt retention, capacity exhaustion and older-state restoration; no deployed-volume restoration

passed.name: read-only recovery storage
passed.coverage: safety-critical admission/replay path fails closed while uncertainty is preserved

passed.name: Docker policy, adoption, capability loss and generation fencing
passed.result: passed against real Docker Desktop daemon in disposable namespaces
passed.evidence: candidate lifecycle and federation Docker canaries
passed.coverage: restart=no, controller-only replacement, retained adoption, stale health fencing and missing capability 503

passed.name: restart-budget exhaustion and recovery reset
passed.coverage: bounded attempts, exhaustion alert/containment and dependency-restored reset behavior; not a real daemon outage

not_run.name: host reboot and unattended guardian boot
not_run.reason: No disposable VM/host was available; rebooting the shared macOS host was outside the authorized isolation boundary
not_run.replacement_evidence: launchd chain and process-supervision fixtures only; does not certify boot integration

not_run.name: Docker daemon restart while idle or during active work
not_run.reason: Docker Desktop serves unrelated containers and live-restore=false; daemon restart would affect them
not_run.replacement_evidence: real Docker lifecycle canaries and command-timeout cleanup only; daemon-side uncertain outcomes remain open

not_run.name: Docker unavailable at startup then restored
not_run.reason: No isolated daemon boundary was available for a safe outage injection
not_run.replacement_evidence: fixture dependency refusal and bounded readiness behavior; no real startup outage

not_run.name: recovery storage full
not_run.reason: No safe quota/full-disk injection was available
not_run.replacement_evidence: local write-error and read-only fixtures; deployed named volume was not filled

not_run.name: retained-state restoration against deployed volume
not_run.reason: No disposable copy of the deployed retained volume was prepared for destructive restore
not_run.replacement_evidence: older snapshot and same-volume replacement fixtures passed; full host restoration remains open

not_run.name: restart-budget exhaustion after a real dependency recovers
not_run.reason: The production guardian budget was deliberately not exhausted and no real daemon outage was injected
not_run.replacement_evidence: fixture exhaustion/reset path passed; production budget remains bounded and observable

soak.limitation: Fixture repetition is evidence of process recovery and request classification, not a Docker-daemon, reboot or production SLA

acceptance.reason: All unperformed destructive subitems remain explicitly open; fixture and disposable Docker evidence is not substituted for host, daemon, storage or retained-state drills
acceptance.next_step: Run each not_run item only inside an isolated host/daemon/storage environment and record fault-to-detection, authority, capability readiness, first request, independent duplicate evidence and cleanup
